summary: legal checked in 3 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Disposition: blocked for new public launches and counsel_required for rights-dependent monetization. SearchWoot remains private; no Woot outreach or public beta is authorized. Existing reversible growth may continue only within evidenced consent, disclosure, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries. Compliance evidence is mixed: 35 pass, 20 fail, 6 unknown; missing banner/accept/reject/GA4 evidence affects 20 sites, and privacy/terms evidence affects 4. Do not treat incomplete telemetry alone as a blocker for ordinary growth.

Keep launch gates unchanged. For SearchWoot, capture the read-only data-flow, retention, deletion, access, correction, notification, log-field, vendor, and consent evidence already identified; do not enable tracking, expand notifications, send outreach, or deploy. For complicated.work, attach dated ownership, preview/build, compliance, security, measurement-boundary, rollback, and explicit-blocker evidence before any publish decision.

The exact current decision is keep SearchWoot private and keep complicated.work parked, private, preview-only, and unlaunched. Human counsel is required for Woot redistribution rights, jurisdictional privacy treatment, and any future affiliate or advertising use. No go-live proposal is supported by the evidence.
